name: codex-goal-retry
description: Goal-only long-interval retry patch manager for the OpenAI Codex VS Code extension.

commands.title: Codex Goal Retry: Inspect Installed Codex
Codex Goal Retry: Apply Goal Retry Patch
Codex Goal Retry: Restore Original Codex Bundle

codexGoalRetry.intervalMinutes.description: Long retry interval in minutes after the built-in Codex goal/heartbeat retry path has failed. Choose 5, 10, or 30 minutes.

codexGoalRetry.codexExtensionId.description: VS Code extension id for the OpenAI Codex extension.

codexGoalRetry.codexExtensionPath.description: Optional absolute path to the OpenAI Codex extension directory. Leave empty to resolve it from VS Code.

scripts.check:syntax: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/patcher.js && node --check scripts/check.js
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run test:patcher
